findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous function calls in greenlet
 * @description Check for potentially dangerous function calls in greenlet Python code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-calls-greenlet
 * @tags security
 */

import python

// Look for function calls that could be dangerous
from Call call
where
  // Check for eval calls
  call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "eval" or
  // Check for exec calls
  call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "exec" or
  // Check for compile calls
  call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "compile" or
  // Check for os.system calls
  (call.getFunc().(Attribute).getObject().(Name).getId() = "os" and 
   call.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = "system") or
  // Check for pickle.load/loads
  (call.getFunc().(Attribute).getObject().(Name).getId() = "pickle" and
   (call.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = "load" or 
    call.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = "loads")) or
  // Check for yaml.load/unsafe_load
  (call.getFunc().(Attribute).getObject().(Name).getId() = "yaml" and
   (call.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = "load" or 
    call.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = "unsafe_load"))
select call, "Potentially dangerous function call: " + call.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Check for dangerous function calls like eval, exec, os.system, pickle.load, yaml.load in the Python code

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File system access with user input
 * @description Checking for file operations with untrusted input
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal-greenlet
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      sink = call.getArg(0) and
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "chmod", "chown", "unlink", "remove", "rename", "listdir"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("os.path").getMember(["join", "abspath", "normpath", "realpath"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["copy", "copyfile", "copytree", "move", "rmtree"]).getACall()
      )
    )
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal vulnerability from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Check for path traversal vulnerabilities in file operations

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Check for dangerous function calls in greenlet
 * @description Looking for potentially dangerous operations in the limited Python code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/greenlet-dangerous-calls
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Check for any eval/exec calls
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    
    // Check for os.system or similar
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    
    // Check for subprocess calls
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall() or
    
    // Check for pickle operations
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    
    // Check for yaml operations
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous function call: " + call.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Checking for dangerous function calls in the greenlet Python code
